cards.answer: Karma is a mage/support who deals magic damage with slowing poke and protects allies with shields and movement speed. Mantra empowers her next basic ability, and hitting enemy champions with damaging abilities helps bring it back sooner.
cards.counterplay: Avoid the poke's splash and account for shielded enemies moving faster when approaching or retreating.

cards.answer: Mantra empowers Karma's next basic ability with an additional effect. cards.counterplay: Expect empowered abilities from the opening level, and avoid repeated ability hits that help Mantra return sooner.

cards.answer: Focused Resolve targets an enemy champion, monster or pet, dealing magic damage and forming a tether that reveals the target. If the tether lasts its full duration, it deals magic damage again and roots the target, keeping them revealed during the root.
cards.counterplay: Prioritize breaking the tether before it completes to avoid its follow-up damage and root.

cards.answer: Renewal is Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve and extends its root duration. It heals Karma based on her missing health when cast, then heals her again if the tether completes or the target dies while tethered.
cards.counterplay: Account for healing when fighting a low-health Karma, and break the tether to prevent its completion-triggered heal and longer root.
